cleanliness.label: Room & Property Cleanliness
question_points: room cleanliness on arrival — spotless or issues noticed
bathroom hygiene — mold, stains, hair on surfaces
bedding and linen freshness — stains, odor, crumbs
dust on furniture, vents, or window sills
odor or smell in room — musty, smoke, sewage
common area cleanliness — lobby, hallways, elevator
pest issues — bugs, cockroaches, ants, bed bugs

staff_service.label: Staff & Service Quality
question_points: friendly and welcoming staff at check-in
helpful front desk — responsive to requests
rude or dismissive service from any staff
housekeeping responsiveness — timely room cleaning
concierge helpfulness — local tips, reservations
problem resolution — how staff handled complaints
language barrier — communication difficulties
went above and beyond — memorable positive interaction

bed_comfort.label: Bed & Sleep Comfort
question_points: mattress firmness — too hard, too soft, just right
pillow quality — flat, lumpy, comfortable, enough pillows
bed size adequate for number of guests
bedding and sheets quality — scratchy, soft, clean
overall sleep quality — slept well or poorly
sofa bed or extra bed comfort if used
blanket or duvet — too thin, too warm, comfortable

breakfast.label: Breakfast Experience
question_points: breakfast included or paid extra
variety of options — continental, buffet, hot items
food quality and freshness
dietary accommodations — vegetarian, gluten-free, halal
breakfast timing and hours — convenient or too limited
seating availability — crowded, had to wait
coffee and beverage quality

bathroom_quality.label: Bathroom Condition & Fixtures
question_points: water pressure — strong, weak, inconsistent
hot water availability — always hot, ran cold, slow to warm
shower space — comfortable size or too cramped
drain working properly or clogged
towel quality and quantity — fresh, worn, enough provided
toilet cleanliness and function
bathroom fixtures — outdated, modern, broken
ventilation — steamy, no fan, mold risk

food_dining.label: Food & Dining Options
question_points: on-site restaurant quality — food, service, ambiance
room service availability and quality
menu variety — enough choices for multiple nights
dietary accommodations — allergies, vegetarian, kids menu
bar or lounge experience — drinks, atmosphere
minibar selection and pricing — reasonable or overpriced
nearby dining options recommended by hotel

noise.label: Noise & Sound Levels
question_points: street traffic noise audible from room
noise from neighboring rooms — voices, TV, footsteps
hallway noise — guests, housekeeping carts, doors slamming
elevator or mechanical noise in room
construction noise during stay
overall quietness — peaceful, could sleep undisturbed
soundproofing quality — thin walls, single-pane windows

family_amenities.label: Family-Friendliness & Amenities
question_points: pool available and suitable for kids
room spacious enough for family
baby crib or rollaway bed available on request
kids play area, game room, or activities
family-friendly dining options on-site
sofa bed quality if used for extra sleeping
child safety — balcony locks, outlet covers, pool fence

check_in_out.label: Check-in & Check-out Process
question_points: wait time at check-in — quick, moderate, long queue
early check-in availability and ease
late check-out availability and ease
key card or room access issues
checkout process — smooth, billing confusion, long wait
express or self-service check-in option
luggage storage before check-in or after checkout

value_price.label: Value for Money
question_points: overall value — price matched quality of stay
hidden or unexpected fees — resort fee, city tax, service charge
room rate reasonable for the area and season
overpriced for what was provided
good deal — would book again at same price
extras worth the cost — upgrades, packages, add-ons
deposit handling — amount, refund timing

parking.label: Parking Availability & Cost
question_points: parking available on-site or nearby
parking cost — free, paid, expensive
lot or garage size — ample space or always full
valet parking offered and experience
street parking availability and safety
electric vehicle charging station available
ease of finding a spot — especially during peak hours

walkability.label: Walkability & Nearby Conveniences
question_points: restaurants and cafes within walking distance
grocery stores or convenience shops nearby
attractions and sightseeing walkable from hotel
shopping options within short walk
sidewalk and pedestrian path quality
area pleasant for walking — scenery, shade, safety

renovation_age.label: Renovation & Property Age
question_points: recently renovated — modern feel, updated fixtures
outdated decor or furnishings — needs refreshing
worn carpet, peeling paint, or scuffed walls
furniture condition — sturdy or wobbly, stained or clean
fixtures working properly — door handles, light switches, faucets
overall property showing its age — tired looking
signs of recent updates — new bathroom, fresh paint, modern TV

room_size.label: Room Size & Layout
question_points: room felt spacious or cramped for number of guests
enough space to open and store luggage
closet or wardrobe storage adequate
bathroom size — roomy or too tight
desk or workspace area if needed
overall layout functional — furniture placement makes sense
room matched photos and description on booking site

transit_convenient.label: Public Transit & Transport Access
question_points: near train or metro station — walking distance
bus stop close to hotel
airport access — shuttle, taxi, public transit ease
ride-share or taxi pickup convenient
public transit frequency and reliability from hotel
clear directions or signage to nearest transit

accessibility.label: Accessibility & Mobility
question_points: elevator available — or stairs only
wheelchair accessible rooms and common areas
hard to manage with heavy luggage — steps, narrow halls
accessible bathroom — grab bars, roll-in shower
ramps or step-free entry to hotel
accessible parking close to entrance

safety_perception.label: Safety & Security Perception
question_points: felt safe in and around the hotel
neighborhood feels safe to walk at night
sketchy or uncomfortable area around property
hotel security measures — cameras, key card access, front desk
well-lit parking and entrance areas
in-room safe available and working

leisure_location.label: Leisure & Scenic Location
question_points: beachfront or beach access — distance, quality
waterfront, lake, or river views from hotel
pool access and pool condition
ocean or sea view from room
resort-like atmosphere or setting
scenic surroundings — gardens, mountain views, nature
